nights.title: Sam Shackleton
nights.name: Sam Shackleton
nights.extract: Sam Shackleton, also known as Sorley the Bard, is a Scottish folk musician, singer-songwriter, and clawhammer banjoist from Stirling. Based in Edinburgh, he records traditional trans-Atlantic folk music and original tracks.

nights.title: Julia Jacklin - North America Tour 2026
nights.name: Julia Jacklin
nights.extract: Julia Jacklin is an Australian singer-songwriter from the Blue Mountains region of New South Wales. Jacklin's musical style has been described as indie pop, indie folk, and alternative country. She has released four studio albums, Don't Let the Kids Win (2016), Crushing (2019), Pre Pleasure (2022) and The Gem (2026). Jacklin has also performed with the band Phantastic Ferniture, with whom she released the debut single "Fuckin 'n' Rollin" and a self-titled album in 2018, followed by subsequent singles.

nights.title: PROTEST THE HERO
nights.name: Protest the Hero
nights.extract: Protest the Hero is a Canadian progressive metal band formed in Whitby, Ontario, in 1999. Originally named Happy Go Lucky, the band changed their name to Protest the Hero and released their debut EP, Search for the Truth, in 2002. In 2005, the band released their first album Kezia on Canadian indie label Underground Operations.
